collectible:3.text: Of the seventeen Daedric Princes, sixteen have an artifact attributed to them in The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim. Before these artifacts can be obtained, however, specific tasks called Daedric quests must be performed. Three of these Daedric quests involve the reward being a choice between two artifacts, those quests being the "The Black Star," "Ill Met by Moonlight," and "A Daedra's Best Friend.
